chapters.title: Welcome Nook
chapters.startStory: Mochi is frightened by every new sound.
chapters.completionStory: Completing the nook gives Mochi the first truly safe sleeping place.

chapters.title: Maker Corner
chapters.startStory: Bean hides beneath the craft desk.
chapters.completionStory: A handmade room teaches Bean that human hands can create comfort.

chapters.title: Reading Nest
chapters.startStory: Pickle watches the doorway instead of resting.
chapters.completionStory: The quiet reading room finally invites Pickle to stay.

chapters.title: Seaside Dayroom
chapters.startStory: Nori is nervous near open windows.
chapters.completionStory: The peaceful sea view becomes a symbol of curiosity instead of fear.

chapters.title: Dreamy Nursery
chapters.startStory: Miso sleeps lightly beside the exit.
chapters.completionStory: The finished nursery lets Miso dream without preparing to run.

chapters.title: Celebration Craft Room
chapters.startStory: Waffle brings broken toys to the house.
chapters.completionStory: Repairing and decorating them creates a welcome kit for future rescues.

chapters.title: Tea & Trust Lounge
chapters.startStory: Taffy will only eat alone.
chapters.completionStory: The shared lounge turns mealtime into a calm family ritual.

chapters.title: Garden Sunroom
chapters.startStory: Sunny is curious about nature but afraid to step outside.
chapters.completionStory: The indoor garden gives Sunny a safe first adventure.

chapters.title: Moonlight Den
chapters.startStory: Pepper wakes at every nighttime noise.
chapters.completionStory: The other cats remain nearby until Pepper learns that the house is safe after dark.

chapters.title: Forever Home Studio
chapters.startStory: Every rescued cat helps finish the final room.
chapters.completionStory: The completed house becomes their permanent shared home.

chapters.title: Bakery Loft
chapters.startStory: Biscuit sleeps on warm flour sacks and trusts no one.
chapters.completionStory: The loft above the ovens becomes Biscuit's toasty home.

chapters.title: Lighthouse Lookout
chapters.startStory: Pearl watches the sea alone from the lighthouse steps.
chapters.completionStory: With a cosy lookout, Pearl finally has company for the night watch.

chapters.title: Greenhouse Glade
chapters.startStory: Basil hides between the tomato vines.
chapters.completionStory: The glade blooms and Basil naps in the sun at last.

chapters.title: Rooftop Garden
chapters.startStory: Kiwi only comes out when the city goes quiet.
chapters.completionStory: A garden in the sky gives Kiwi a calm place above the noise.

chapters.title: Library Hideaway
chapters.startStory: Quill curls up behind the dustiest shelf.
chapters.completionStory: Quill now reads along on a cushion by the window.

chapters.title: Music Room
chapters.startStory: Bonbon flinches at every note.
chapters.completionStory: Soft music and a snug corner turn Bonbon into the room's biggest fan.

chapters.title: Art Attic
chapters.startStory: Hazel leaves paw prints on every canvas, then runs.
chapters.completionStory: The attic becomes Hazel's studio, paw prints and all.

chapters.title: Winter Cabin
chapters.startStory: Ember shivers by a cold fireplace.
chapters.completionStory: A crackling fire and a deep blanket keep Ember warm all winter.

chapters.title: Picnic Porch
chapters.startStory: Daisy steals sandwiches and bolts into the hedge.
chapters.completionStory: Daisy now waits politely for her share on the porch.

chapters.title: Toy Workshop
chapters.startStory: Nugget chews every toy he finds.
chapters.completionStory: A workshop full of his own toys makes Nugget the happiest helper.

chapters.title: Tea Garden
chapters.startStory: Lychee hides under the teahouse steps.
chapters.completionStory: Lychee now greets every guest by the steaming teapot.

chapters.title: Starlight Observatory
chapters.startStory: Velvet only trusts the stars.
chapters.completionStory: From her new perch Velvet counts the stars with a friend.

chapters.title: Harbour Boathouse
chapters.startStory: Saffron lives on a leaky rowing boat.
chapters.completionStory: A dry boathouse lets Saffron dream of the sea in comfort.

chapters.title: Flower Shop
chapters.startStory: Rosie sneezes at every bouquet and hides.
chapters.completionStory: A quiet corner of the shop gives Rosie a home among the petals.

chapters.title: Cosy Café
chapters.startStory: Churro begs at the café door in the rain.
chapters.completionStory: Churro now has a reserved seat by the coffee machine.

chapters.title: Puppet Theatre
chapters.startStory: Ziggy is scared of the puppets' shadows.
chapters.completionStory: Ziggy now steals the show every night.

chapters.title: Candle Workshop
chapters.startStory: Juniper keeps away from every flicker.
chapters.completionStory: Gentle candlelight makes Juniper's workshop the calmest room in town.

chapters.title: Orchard Barn
chapters.startStory: Acorn sleeps in the apple crates.
chapters.completionStory: The barn becomes Acorn's sweet-smelling home.

chapters.title: Snowy Chalet
chapters.startStory: Marble is lost in the snow.
chapters.completionStory: Marble now watches the snowflakes from a warm window seat.

chapters.title: Grand Festival Hall
chapters.startStory: The whole neighbourhood gathers for one last celebration.
chapters.completionStory: Every cat now has a home, and the festival never ends.
